claims.claim: Correction Preflight regressions previously embedded in tests/test_operator.py are represented by an independently runnable tests/test_operator_correction_preflight.py group that preserves read-only readiness, exact lineage/selector, action, scope, executor-required, and fail-closed admission semantics established by TASK-085 and later hardening.

Unified State / Next Action regressions previously embedded in tests/test_operator.py are represented by an independently runnable tests/test_operator_unified_state.py group that preserves deterministic lifecycle reduction, exact correction continuity, ambiguity fail-closed behavior, terminal validation, and no mutation/reconciliation semantics established by TASK-086 and later hardening.

Unified Human Surface / continue delegation regressions previously embedded in tests/test_operator.py are represented by an independently runnable tests/test_operator_human_surface.py group that preserves exact next-action delegation, explicit Executor requirements, at-most-one-operation behavior, and stop-after-return/failure semantics established by TASK-087/TASK-088 and later hardening.

The decomposition introduces no production-code delta and no semantic test-coverage loss: moved tests retain their material assertions and scenarios, unrelated Operator tests remain covered, no moved regression is duplicated across groups, and no test is skipped or xfailed to satisfy the new layout.

Any extracted tests/operator_test_support.py content is test-only shared support with no collected test cases, no production authority, no duplicate test-module import side effects, and no order dependency.

The final candidate proves that tests/test_operator.py, all three correction groups, and tests/test_review_transport.py collect and pass together under one canonical pytest invocation, while each correction group remains a stable file-level target suitable for future REMEDIATION affected_verification without Runtime heuristics.

Runtime, REVIEW/REMEDIATION/REPAIR contracts, existing verification/evidence ownership, CODE_FIX/NO_CHANGE/CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION behavior, publication, executor selection, retry/reroute policy, and frozen Kernel v0.1 artifacts remain unchanged.
